entries.name: Normal speed breaker
entries.description: Marked speed hump of typical profile.

entries.name: Medium speed breaker
entries.description: Moderate-profile hump requiring clear speed reduction.

entries.name: High speed breaker
entries.description: Tall hump that can strike the underbody of low vehicles.

entries.name: Unmarked speed breaker
entries.description: Hump without paint or warning sign; very hard to see at night.

entries.name: Oversized hump
entries.description: Hump far larger than typical calming devices.

entries.name: Sharp-edged hump
entries.description: Hump with a steep or square edge.

entries.name: Broken speed breaker
entries.description: Damaged hump with broken edges or exposed material.

entries.name: Multiple speed breakers
entries.description: Series of humps in quick succession.

entries.name: Rumble strips
entries.description: Transverse raised strips producing vibration and noise.

entries.name: Raised pedestrian crossing
entries.description: Crossing built as a flat-topped hump.

entries.name: Speed cushion
entries.description: Partial-width humps that wide vehicles can straddle.

entries.name: Sudden road elevation
entries.description: Abrupt rise in road level, e.g. at a culvert or new layer.

entries.name: Railway crossing hump
entries.description: Raised track bed creating a hump at a level crossing.
